title: Each session, agent and sprint names its operator: a pseudonymous operator id from the Claude login
goal: kbwho.py prints the operator's pseudonymous id, where it came from and the session's role, read from KB_OPERATOR, else the email of claude auth status, else git config user.email, mapped to an alias in the uncommitted _private/operators.json, and prints the email only with --show-email; backlog.py records the operator id as a new sprint's creator, beside a claim's claimed_by and on a gate the operator answers, and set SP --owner records a sprint's owner; dispatch gives each worker KB_OPERATOR and KB_ROLE=worker, and the worker's brief and its dispatch record name both; the coord hook's intents carry the operator id and kbmon's sessions panel shows it; coord.py list --by-operator shows each operator's live claims and approved budgets
